title: Drunk Mom Loses Custody Of Her Kids After Having Too Much To Drink
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On June 17th, 2023. Officers were dispatched to the beach in reference to a woman who hit another persons car & tried to flee the scene. When the officers approached her, they noticed she had multiple kids in the car and she was highly intoxicated & she tried to deny ever hitting the persons car. Officers then had to call the dad to come get the kids since the parents were divorced. After a while she started to get mad at the officers and started to make various threats towards them and blame the officers for taking the kids. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
